text:
marta: Quick heads-up — CI eval for the new quantized summarization model is jittering. About 30% of runs fail the regression gate with BLEU dropping ~0.6-0.8. Logs attached.
pranav: Is it a sampling/temperature/top_p change or pure numeric drift after quantize?
li: I've seen similar with per-channel int8 on A100s when batch > 1. Fused kernels can change op ordering and amplify FP rounding differences.
emily: This is the eval harness though — we set a global seed for the runner. Did we change worker pooling last week? commit 9f2b1c8 touched runner/worker_pool.
marta: Reproducer command we use in CI:```./tools/eval-runner --suite summarization --model rlm-3b-q8 --quantize int8 --batch-size 4 --top_p 0.92 --parallel-workers 2```CI job sets no extra envs.
kevin: Try this minimal:```# single-worker deterministic run
REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 \
./tools/eval-runner --suite summarization --model rlm-3b-q8 --quantize int8 --batch-size 1 --parallel-workers 1 --seed 42 --no-streaming```
kevin: If that passes consistently then it's an interaction of batching/parallelism + kernel reorder.
pranav: Also check metrics pipeline — some ROUGE/BLEU calc libs are multithreaded and non-deterministic. Set ROUGE_THREAD_COUNT=1 during runs.
ci-bot: ci-bot: queued rerun of job #4582 (attempt 2) :repeat: 
marta: Reran locally with single-worker + batch-size=1 + seed=42 x5 -> PASS. With batch-size=4 + parallel-workers=2 it fails 2/5 times, so pretty clearly an interaction.
emily: Two mitigations: 1) fast: add a flake-retry in CI (rerun up to 2x before failing) so PRs don't get blocked; 2) longer: add deterministic microtests and telemetry to catch which kernel/mode caused drift. Thoughts? :thinking:
li: I'll prototype a microtest that runs the same prompt token-by-token comparing fp16 vs q8 outputs with identical seed and no-batching, then repeat with batch>1. If mismatch only shows up in batch>1 that's telling.
pranav: I'll instrument eval-runner to emit small telemetry: seed, worker_id, batch_order_hash, quant_mode, REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS, and a short token-hash snapshot for failing cases. I'll also add a flag to fail-fast when token hashes diverge. This feeds the Console dashboard so we can correlate across failures.
marta: Filing INF-927 with the reproducer, logs and the failing BLEU snippets. @pranav @li @kevin can you coordinate on patches + a small dashboard card? :eyes:
ci-bot: ci-bot: created issue INF-927 and linked PR #4123 -> https://git.redwood.ai/infra/INF-927
kevin: For immediate unblock I'll add `retry-on-flake: 2` to the CI job (small PR). Follow-ups: disable fused kernels by default for quantized evals until we have a root cause.
pranav: Will push telemetry branch and a tiny deterministic test this afternoon. If anyone wants to pair on the kernel trace I can set up a short debug session.
marta: Great — thanks all. Keeping this thread as the coordination log.
